error.message: Storage or output I/O prevented completion.

remediation.summary: The path you gave is not a regular file: it is a named pipe, a device or a socket, and VSift does not open those. Nothing was read or copied, and no storage failed (for a socket the code is the closest published one). VSift reads only regular files, such as a video saved on a disk. Name the video file itself and run the command again. If you do not know which file the user means, ask the user.
